coordinates.x: from the left wall (chairs side) toward the right wall (door side)
coordinates.z: from the shelf wall (z = 0) toward the wall behind the racks
coordinates.plan_view: top view with the shelf wall at the top and the door on the right

provenance.measured: taken with a tape on site; value is the reading
provenance.range: two readings disagreed; min and max are both kept, value is the midpoint used for geometry
provenance.derived: computed from measured values; not measured directly
provenance.assumed: estimated from photos or typical sizes; must be re-measured before it is trusted

rack_type.note: Fixed by decision of the team: every rack is 600 x 1000 x 2040. Units: floor(((2040 - 160) / 44.45)) = 42, U1 starts 100 mm above the floor (assumed plinth + top cap of 160 mm in total).

rack_measurements.front_faces_toward: the shelf (z decreases from back to front)

gaps_x_left_to_right.note: measured 1495-1500; the 600 mm fixed width leaves 1510. Re-measure.

rack_measurements.conflict: With depth fixed at 1000 the back gaps disagree with the tape by up to 40 mm (r1, r4). Either those racks are shallower than 1000 or a reading is off. Re-measure r1 and r4 depth and back gap.

shelf.name: Стелаж colocation (Tower)

z0.note: gap to the wall not measured

shelf.cell_numbering: top board 1-14, middle board 15-28 (plates on the boards), bottom board has no plates

airflow.note: supply/return direction, flow (m3/h) and set point were not recorded. Needed for any airflow model.

door.opens: inward, leaf swings toward the shelf wall

cable_tray.route: along the left wall and the wall behind the racks

not_modelled_or_assumed_only: light fittings, smoke detectors, camera, electrical panel, thermostats, chairs: positions from photos only
power: no data yet (UPS, PDUs, breakers, feeds)
remeasure: r1 and r4: depth and gap from back to wall
gap from r4 to the right wall
shelf: gap to its wall, height of the middle board, left gap (200 or 300)
air conditioners: depth, gap to the shelf wall, airflow direction and rated flow
